judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

R. Vijayakumar, J.:— The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition and he has also given a letter dated 2-6-2026 to the Registry to that effect.

2. In view of the above, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed as withdrawn. Consequently connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
